summary:
### Scene Context

The video captures a rural agricultural landscape with open green fields, a distant tree line, a small building, and a clear blue sky. The camera performs a tracking pan following an airborne object across the frame. Media sourced from `fx05.mp4`.

### Drone Visibility

A **multirotor drone** (likely a DJI Phantom-class UAV) is clearly visible throughout the entire clip. The four-rotor configuration, body structure, and landing gear are distinctly identifiable in every frame. Confidence is very high (~95%).

### Approximate Frame Position

| Time | Position |
|------|----------|
| 0.0s | upper-left |
| 1.0s | upper-left / upper-center |
| 2.0s | upper-center |
| 3.0s | center |
| 4.0s | center-right |
| 5.0s | lower-right |
| 6.0s | lower-right (near ground) |
| 7.0s | center |
| 8.0s | center-right |
| 9.0s | upper-center |

### Motion Interpretation

The drone is **moving** throughout the clip. It traverses from upper-left to lower-right (descending), briefly reaches ground level around 5-6s, then ascends back into the center of the frame. There is no hovering; displacement is continuous and significant.

### Tracking Status

The same drone is reliably tracked across all frames. Visibility is continuous with no occlusion or loss of identity.

### First Visible Event

The drone is visible from the **very first frame (0.0s)**. A first-visible event is emitted at t=0.

### Zone State

The virtual restricted zone covers the central third of the image (approximately x: 213–427, y: 160–320 in a 640×480 frame).

| Time | Zone State |
|------|------------|
| 0.0–1.0s | OUTSIDE |
| 2.0s | APPROACHING |
| 3.0–4.0s | INSIDE_RESTRICTED_ZONE |
| 5.0s | EXITED |
| 6.0s | OUTSIDE |
| 7.0–9.0s | INSIDE_RESTRICTED_ZONE (re-entry) |

### Zone Intrusion Events

- **DRONE_ZONE_INTRUSION #1** at ~3.0s: drone crosses from outside into the restricted zone.
- **DRONE_ZONE_INTRUSION #2** at ~7.0s: drone re-enters the restricted zone after having exited.

### Conclusion

A clearly identifiable multirotor drone is tracked across the full clip, moving through the restricted zone twice. Two DRONE_ZONE_INTRUSION events are emitted. Impact is assessed as **high**.
